newsitem.title: UK: Racal acquires Josef Heim KG.
newsitem.headline: Racal acquires Josef Heim KG.

text.p: Racal Recorders, a unit of Racal Electronics Plc, on Tuesday said it acquired Josef Heim KG, a German instrumentation recording company, for 13.8 million marks in cash.
Racal said it has formed a new company, Racal-Heim GmbH, devoted exclusively to developing the group's instrumentation recording activities.

The company will assume responsibility for the design, engineering and supply of Racal's instrumentation recording products and systems worldwide and will principally address customers in the automotive, aerospace and defence sectors.
Josef Heim had 1995 profits of 2.9 million marks on turnover of 8.7 million marks.
